name: Celeriac, White Miso & Sesame
desc: Velvety celeriac with the umami of white miso and a toasty sesame finish.
ing: 230 g celeriac, peeled and diced into 1 cm pieces
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Stir in the crème fraîche after the programme and serve hot.
science: Celeriac provides vegetables and fibre; miso and sesame build savoury depth without requiring frying.
note: New recipe idea HS-016; not yet kitchen-tested. Miso and stock may already provide enough salt; contains soy, sesame and milk.

name: Parsnip, Bramley Apple & Sage
desc: An earthy British winter soup, with Bramley sharpness and aromatic sage.
ing: 240 g parsnips, peeled and diced into 1 cm pieces
70 g Bramley apple, peeled, cored and diced
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Taste before adding any extra seasoning; keep the apple subtle.
science: Parsnip adds fibre and carbohydrate; Bramley apple gives restrained acidity rather than sweetness.
note: New recipe idea HS-018; not yet kitchen-tested. Use a tart cooking apple; check stock and mustard labels for allergens.

name: Savoy Cabbage, Smoked Cheddar & White Bean
desc: Creamy cannellini beans, winter cabbage and smoky Cheddar, with a whisper of caraway.
ing: 160 g Savoy cabbage, very finely shredded
240 g tinned cannellini beans, drained (from a 400 g tin)
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Stir the finely chopped smoked Cheddar into the finished hot soup until melted, then serve.
science: Beans add fibre and plant protein; cabbage contributes vegetables and Cheddar adds calcium and richness.
note: New recipe idea HS-020; not yet kitchen-tested. Contains milk. Chop cheese finely so it melts without needing a saucepan.

name: Smoky Black Bean, Ancho & Cocoa
desc: Dark, smoky black beans with ancho chilli, cumin and a subtle savoury cocoa note.
ing: 240 g tinned black beans, drained (from a 400 g tin)
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Taste; add a little more chilli only if wanted.
science: Black beans supply fibre and plant protein. Cocoa is a flavour note, not a nutritional supplement.
note: New recipe idea HS-021; not yet kitchen-tested. Use unsweetened cocoa, not drinking chocolate. Pour water into the jug first to minimise sticking.

name: Fennel, Anchovy & Preserved Lemon
desc: Fragrant fennel with anchovy umami and a restrained lift from preserved lemon.
ing: ½ tsp finely chopped preserved lemon rind
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Taste before salting; preserved lemon and anchovies are already salty.
science: Fennel contributes vegetables; beans provide fibre and anchovies add a concentrated savoury flavour.
note: New recipe idea HS-022; not yet kitchen-tested. Contains fish. Preserved lemon and anchovies can be salty; use low-salt stock.

name: Artichoke, Green Olive & Basil
desc: A silky, herbaceous Mediterranean soup of artichokes, olives and basil.
ing: 180 g jarred artichoke hearts in brine, drained
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Taste and serve; avoid salting until after tasting.
science: Artichoke and beans contribute vegetables and fibre; olives and olive oil supply unsaturated fats.
note: New recipe idea HS-023; not yet kitchen-tested. Choose artichokes in brine, not strongly vinegar-pickled. Check whether the artichokes contain tough leaves before blending.

name: Beetroot, Curry Leaf & Coconut
desc: Vivid beetroot with a Sri Lankan-inspired combination of coconut, curry leaf and warm spices.
ing: 240 g plain ready-cooked beetroot, diced (not pickled)
¼ tsp dried crushed curry leaves
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Stir in the lime juice after cooking and taste.
science: Beetroot contributes fibre and folate; coconut adds richness but also saturated fat.
note: New recipe idea HS-024; not yet kitchen-tested. Use plain cooked beetroot, not vinegar-pickled beetroot; a 200 ml coconut milk carton limits leftovers.

name: Cauliflower, Peanut & Lime
desc: Silky cauliflower with savoury peanut, coconut, ginger and bright lime.
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Stir in the lime juice after the programme, then taste.
science: Cauliflower provides vegetables; peanuts contribute unsaturated fats and some protein.
note: New recipe idea HS-025; not yet kitchen-tested. Contains peanuts and soy; light soy sauce may contain wheat. Use smooth peanut butter and place liquid in the jug first.

name: Chicken, Leek & Tarragon Velouté
desc: Classic creamy chicken and leek with aromatic tarragon and a silky bean base.
ing: 120 g plain ready-to-eat cooked chicken breast, chopped
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Stir in the crème fraîche and serve piping hot; ensure all cooked chicken has been heated thoroughly.
science: Chicken adds lean protein, while cannellini beans contribute fibre and creaminess.
note: New recipe idea HS-026; not yet kitchen-tested. Only use fully cooked, ready-to-eat chicken; never raw chicken. This differs from the existing Chicken, Mushroom & Tarragon Cream by using leek and beans. Contains milk.

name: Smoked Mackerel, Leek & Dill
desc: A deeply savoury smooth smoked-fish soup with tender leek, potato and dill.
ing: 100 g ready-to-eat hot-smoked mackerel, skin and visible bones removed
80 g potato, peeled and diced into 1 cm pieces
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Stir in crème fraîche and lemon juice, then serve piping hot.
science: Oily mackerel supplies protein, long-chain omega-3 fats and vitamin B12.
note: New recipe idea HS-027; not yet kitchen-tested. Use ready-to-eat hot-smoked mackerel, not raw fish; inspect for bones. Contains fish and milk.

name: Red Cabbage, Sour Cherry & Juniper
desc: A dramatic dark-purple winter soup with savoury cabbage, sour cherry and resinous juniper.
ing: 200 g red cabbage, very finely shredded
method: Wash, peel and chop any fresh produce as specified. Use only fully cooked, ready-to-eat meat or fish where listed.
Pour approximately 125 ml cold water into your Morphy Richards 501021. Add all ingredients except those marked (finish).
Top up with cold water to approximately 850–900 ml TOTAL contents, keeping everything between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the full Smooth programme (approximately 19 minutes).
Taste for balance; add no additional cherry unless needed.
science: Red cabbage provides vegetables and fibre; the preserve adds some sugar and a controlled tart-fruit accent.
note: New recipe idea HS-029; not yet kitchen-tested. Use only one juniper berry initially. Shred the cabbage very finely for the 19-minute Smooth cycle.
